name: Juno Pad Dyn

beschreibung.text: Juno pad with chorus, echo, hall and a compressor built in: wide, ready-made chords at the graph's own knob positions.

notiz: Reproduces the graph's default sound (every knob at its own default position, 0.5) so the instrument stays reachable as a sound after it left the pickers. Not heard separately (2026-11-18).
